title: Extend legacy report generator with metadata sidecar and search in 3 steps
description: Multi-step Python task: add ReportMeta dataclass, JSON sidecar support, and a full-text search function to the legacy report generator.

task_spec.prompt:
Extend src/report_gen.py in three steps. All 5 existing tests must still pass.

Step 1 — ReportMeta dataclass + write with metadata:
  @dataclasses.dataclass
  class ReportMeta:
      title: str
      created_at: str   # ISO-8601 datetime string
      row_count: int

  def write_report_with_meta(report_dir: str, title: str, rows: list[list[str]]) -> tuple[str, str]
    — calls write_html_report to produce report.html
    — writes a JSON sidecar at report_dir/report.meta.json containing title, created_at (datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()), row_count
    — returns (html_path, meta_path)

Step 2 — Read metadata + list with metadata:
  def read_meta(report_dir: str) -> ReportMeta | None
    — reads report_dir/report.meta.json and returns a ReportMeta; returns None if file not found

  def list_reports_with_meta(base_dir: str) -> list[tuple[str, ReportMeta]]
    — returns sorted list of (report_name, meta) for reports that have a .meta.json sidecar

Step 3 — Full-text search:
  def search_reports(base_dir: str, query: str) -> list[str]
    — returns sorted list of report names whose report.html contains query (case-insensitive)
    — reports without a report.html are skipped

All 5 existing tests must still pass.
Run: pytest
required_artifacts: write_report_with_meta creates both HTML and .meta.json sidecar
read_meta returns ReportMeta with correct fields, None when file missing
list_reports_with_meta returns only reports that have a sidecar
search_reports returns sorted names with case-insensitive match
followup_prompts: Good progress. Run `pytest` to see where we stand. Continue with the remaining steps, prioritizing the parts the tests depend on most.
Final push: run `pytest` and fix any remaining failures. Make sure the full implementation is complete and all tests pass.
